evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: NOT PRESENT — Nicole never frames the 10–15 minute call structure or asks for permission to proceed before launching into availability/rate discussion.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: NOT PRESENT — Nicole never asks 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' The caller (AI assistant for Devon) drives all questioning; Nicole only responds to what is asked.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Nicole provides a range ($842.50 to $997) but does not anchor it to a typical home size or personalize it to Devon's specific move concerns (stair carry, unknown inventory). Range is reactive to the caller's inventory recitation, not proactive framing.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: FULL — Nicole clearly states: 'That's for three movers and one truck, everything is included in the hourly rate, like the fuel and truck taxes, insurance. All wrap pads and bans to protect the items... no hidden fees of any type no credit card fees, no steri fees, no disassemble or reassembly fees... two and a half hours once we go over the minimum the time is per rated in fifteen minute increments.'
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: NOT ASKED — After providing the final estimate ($842.50 to $997), Nicole does not ask 'Does that feel fair?' or pause for the customer's reaction.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: FULL — 'we have on time guarantee if we cannot make it in the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: FULL — 'we have no worries damage coverage. We provide up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse, for any accidental damages.' (Framed as built-in, no deductible/fine print mentioned but no contradictory language either.)
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: NO — Nicole never asks 'Does that put those to rest?' or confirms the customer has no remaining concerns about the two promises. The call ends abruptly after the booking validity question.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: NEVER — Nicole never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' or any equivalent close. The caller asks about estimate validity and booking cutoff; Nicole answers but does not pivot to asking for the business.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: PARTIAL — Date (tomorrow, 8:30–9:00 AM), addresses (both confirmed), and crew size (three movers) are confirmed. Missing: phone number for Devon, arrival window confirmation (8:30–9:00 AM is mentioned but not re-confirmed as booked), and no notes left for the crew about stair carry or customer concerns.

top_strength: Nicole delivered clear, comprehensive pricing framing with no hidden fees, minimum/increment structure, and both promised benefits (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) fully articulated.
coaching_note: This call was caller-driven, not rep-driven — Nicole responded reactively to every question but never asked 'What are your biggest concerns?' at the start (Section 2), never framed the 10–15 minute call structure (Section 1), never asked 'Does that feel fair?' after the estimate (Section 4), and never asked for the business at the end (Section 7); reframe to regain control of the discovery and close.
